title: Account levels
intro: Choose what each account may do. A level counts only for an account that is protected by a login.

help.user: Plays and makes private or hidden jigsaws.
help.admin: Also changes and deletes anything, sees private jigsaws and sets levels.

needsLogin: Not protected by a login: it can only be a user.
couldNotSave: Could not save the level: try again.
publicLocked: Only a publisher can make a jigsaw public.

into.banner: You are using {{ name }} as an admin.
into.notAllowed: Only an admin can go into an account.
